p: were on this side Jordan: In respect to the plain of Moab.
great sea over against Lebanon: The main sea called the Mediterranean.
bound up: Because they were all worn.
Hivites: For the Gibeonites and the Hivites were all one people.
the name of the LORD thy: Even the idolaters for fear of death will pretend to honour the true God, and receive his religion.
bread we took hot for our: The wicked lack no art, nor spare no lies to set forth their policy, when they will deceive the servants of God.
men took of their victuals: Some think that the Israelites are of their victuals, and so made a league with them.
murmured against the princes: Fearing lest for their sin the plague of God would have come on them all.
oath which we sware unto them: This does not establish rash oaths, but shows God's mercy toward his, who would not punish them for their sin.
the house of my God: For the use of the tabernacle and the temple when it will be built.
hand of the children of Israel: Who were minded to put them to death for fear of God's wrath.
altar of the LORD: That is, for the service of the temple, as in Jos 9:23.
